falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5600 on any daily session within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match (which formed at ~5200 after a 8.5% drawdown), proving the correction ended and the structural bear case failed

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained complacency at pre-correction levels would falsify the bottoming narrative, as August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking at 38.57 and remaining elevated for weeks; rapid normalization implies no capitulation occurred

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield breaks above 4.50% while SPX simultaneously trades above 5400
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination would violate the stagflationary/recessionary macro signal embedded in the pattern, as August 2024 bottom coincided with yields collapsing to 3.85%; it would confirm a growth scare rather than cycle downturn, invalidating the defensive positioning call

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
